repairs: Parent P1: replaced accidentally selected shortened boss profile with complete lock/projectile/charge/summon configuration.
Parent P1: initialized previous Unit x/y at body creation; immediate contact remains finite.
Native: preserved 3000ms revival deadline and surviving HP across stage/boss entry; cancelled old abilities/owned projectiles on cleanup.
Native: removed registry name shadow in inventory UI and corrected renderer variable conversion and slate resize.
Common boss charge clears per-target contact memory for each execution.
Verification-only: one-time saved fixture injection no longer overwrites reload; legacy save assertion compares durable fields, not optional false defaults.
limits: Constructed Unit/Matter tests are separate from native E2E; their injected actor geometry and deterministic RNG are not claimed as organic gameplay.
Native E2E uses a valid preboot growth/inventory fixture and native UI/input; no runtime HP, position, stage, timing or RNG forcing.
Native observation is representative and short; no every-species/every-grade matrix, drop-frequency statistical estimate, mobile, long-run balance or performance guarantee.
Two boss owners and both summon species are proven in the constructed contract; native run proves simultaneous boss pets/abilities without requiring the full summon sequence organically.
Pages workflow only runs on main; draft PR is not a deployment and public remains 0.12.3 until separately merged.
